example_condition: Force offline mode in DevTools; interact with cached shell; check events reach GA4 on reconnect; GTM excluded from aggressive caching

label: Page-load-speed tag-firing starvation
criteria: Tags fire before users abandon slow pages
business_effect: Slow pages lose tag fires; loss misread as config bug
example_condition: Chrome DevTools Performance load-time profile correlated with bounce or exit spikes on slow pages

label: Bot/spam detection
criteria: Bot and spam sessions identified and excluded from reporting
business_effect: Bot and synthetic sessions inflate traffic (source example: ad-network bot 30% of a month)
example_condition: 0 percent engagement referrals; event-per-session outliers via BigQuery; sessions with events but no session_start or page_view; technical and synthetic URLs recorded as landing pages; ad-network measurement bots

label: Spike/drop alerts
criteria: Alerts on critical events and partner data lag; health score from six named sub-scores; continuous tag-integrity crawling between audits
business_effect: Accidental tag removal or CSP blocks go unnoticed between audits
example_condition: Custom Insights email alerts; daily anomaly check on critical events; partner ingestion lag alerts; six-part health score; scheduled tag-integrity crawlers

label: Sampling
criteria: Reports unsampled or sampling level known
business_effect: Sampled reports skew totals and ratios
example_condition: Data quality icon percentage on reports; BigQuery used for unsampled data

label: High-cardinality dimensions
criteria: No unique-value params registered as dimensions
business_effect: Unique values destroy reports into (other) row
example_condition: Registered custom params checked for unique values; share of (other) rows

label: URL parameter bloat
criteria: Unique URLs reduced to a manageable set (Tharaa case 838k to about 300); page_location within limit
business_effect: Unique URL explosion makes page reports unusable; long URLs truncated
example_condition: Exclusion list for variant, page, gclid, fbclid, _pos, _sid, _ss; unique URL count; page_location 1000-char ceiling monitored

label: Parameter drift
criteria: Version-controlled data layer spec; weekly completeness checks; no duplicate events; no spoofed hostnames; blank hostname checked against legitimate causes before filtering
business_effect: Silent param loss; double-firing non-ecommerce events; spoofed traffic on Measurement ID
example_condition: Per-event completeness percent; duplicate events by event_name, event_timestamp and user_pseudo_id; blank page_title on SPA route change; session_start and first page_view pairing; hostname report for spoofed domains

label: Health governance
criteria: Cadence and SLAs defined and followed
business_effect: Tracking issues sit unresolved without owners and timelines
example_condition: Daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly review cadence in place; SLAs 24h, 72h and 5d

label: GA4 Data/Admin API quota-aware pipelines
criteria: Automated pulls respect per-property token and concurrency quotas and handle throttling
business_effect: Pipeline fails quietly on quota exhaustion, returning partial data; Looker Studio reports break
example_condition: API usage vs property quota dashboard; check whether automated jobs log or alert on 429 responses

label: BigQuery reconciliation SQL patterns
criteria: Critical param null rate near 0 percent; no duplicate-firing outliers; no duplicate transaction IDs; user_id coverage tracks login rate; revenue field valid type
business_effect: Silent param drop, double purchase firing (native + GTM), broken auth tracking or wrong revenue type go unnoticed for weeks
example_condition: Monthly: null rate of critical params by event_name; users with more than 50 distinct sessions; duplicate transaction_id count; user_id coverage daily; purchase revenue value type check

label: Site search
criteria: Non-standard search param added in EM advanced settings and registered
business_effect: Search behaviour not tracked, false negatives in diagnosis
example_condition: Confirm site search param against default EM list of q, s, search, query, keyword; search_query dimension registered

label: CTA clicks
criteria: CTA clicks pushed to dataLayer
business_effect: Selector-based CTA tracking is fragile
example_condition: CTA clicks tracked via dataLayer.push rather than CSS selectors

label: SPA virtual pageviews
criteria: Virtual pageviews fire on every SPA view
business_effect: Pageviews missed on SPA route changes
example_condition: History Change trigger and per-view clearing in place (see 2.17)

label: 404 / error-page tracking
criteria: Broken-page visits fire a dedicated error event
business_effect: Untracked 404s make broken journeys and dead inbound links invisible
example_condition: Visit a nonexistent URL and check for error event in DebugView; Clarity Copilot query on unexpected 404 spikes

label: Element Visibility triggers
criteria: Impression claims backed by visibility triggers, not page_view proxies
business_effect: Every impression claim is really a page_view proxy
example_condition: Element Visibility triggers configured for promo banners, below-fold modules and ad units where viewability is a goal

label: Form interaction tracking
criteria: form_start fires on first field interaction; no double count with custom form tags
business_effect: Form abandonment invisible; double counts from parallel tags
example_condition: Enhanced Measurement form_start toggle enabled and firing; form_start not doubled by custom form-submit tags; form_start and form_submit paired for abandonment

label: Engaged-session / engagement_time_msec threshold fit
criteria: Threshold matches the business content pattern
business_effect: Engagement rate undercounts true engagement and misleads stakeholders
example_condition: Default 10-second engaged-session threshold vs actual content consumption; raised to 30 to 60 seconds for long-form sites

label: Session timeout customization
criteria: Timeout matches real journey length
business_effect: Single long journey split into many sessions, fragmenting funnel and attribution
example_condition: Default 30-minute timeout reviewed against user behaviour; configurable up to 7 hours 55 minutes

label: Self-hosted / Vimeo video milestones
criteria: Video events fire on the actual player in use
business_effect: Video events silently never fire despite being configured
example_condition: Custom player SDK listeners for Vimeo, Video.js or HTML5 video; enablejsapi=1 on YouTube embeds

label: Scroll-after-timeout phantom session
criteria: Returning scroll-only visits do not create sessions without page_view
business_effect: Landing page reports show (not set) for phantom sessions
example_condition: Custom scroll milestones at 75 and 90 percent; landing-page report for (not set) on sessions starting with scroll only

label: Page-title x event cross-validation
criteria: Checkout page-title views equal begin_checkout count
business_effect: Checkout funnel counts mismatch, indicating trigger error
example_condition: Checkout page-title view count compared with begin_checkout count

label: Conversion-count sanity ratio
criteria: Ratio at or below 1.5
business_effect: Platform conversions overstate sales and inflate ROAS
example_condition: Platform conversions divided by actual transactions; ratio above 1.5 indicates wrong trigger (Tharaa case 133x)

label: Month-over-month event-volume comparison
criteria: No unexplained volume jumps isolating bot windows
business_effect: Bot contamination goes unnoticed within a window
example_condition: Month-over-month event volume comparison

label: Duplicate transaction-ID query
criteria: Equal counts, no duplicate transaction IDs
business_effect: Duplicate purchases inflate revenue and ROAS
example_condition: count(transaction_id) vs count(distinct transaction_id)

label: Not-set percentage per item dimension
criteria: Not 100 percent not-set; 100 percent indicates schema field-name mismatch
business_effect: Item-level reporting empty due to schema mismatch
example_condition: Not-set percentage per item dimension

label: Behavioral validation via session recordings
criteria: Recording and event sequence match; no ghost events or wrong triggers
business_effect: Ghost events, wrong triggers and drop-off causes invisible in quantitative data
example_condition: Spot-check 5 user journeys per audit in Clarity recordings against GA4 event sequence

label: AOV-canceling-error check
criteria: Count and AOV both match backend, not just aggregate revenue within 5 percent
business_effect: Duplicate-transaction and missing-line-item bugs cancel out in aggregate revenue check
example_condition: Compare GA4 transaction count to backend count and GA4 AOV to backend AOV separately

label: Item-sum vs transaction-value cross-check
criteria: Item sum reconciles to transaction value
business_effect: Miscoded value fields or missing/duplicated items invisible to a transaction-count-only check
example_condition: SUM of items price times quantity vs ecommerce value per transaction, adjusting for shipping, tax and discount

label: Cohort retention cross-check vs backend
criteria: Cohort numbers match backend retention within tolerance; applies to subscription or membership businesses
business_effect: Retention misreported; stitching gaps hidden (subscription/SaaS/membership)
example_condition: GA4 cohort or retention numbers spot-checked against backend retention for the same window

label: Consent signal and privacy compliance
criteria: Clarity consent signal sent via Consent API; default auto-collect off; CMP gates script for EEA, UK and CH
business_effect: Clarity collects EU data without consent; custom consent integration breaks tracking entirely
example_condition: Settings cookie-consent toggle off; CMP requests consent before Clarity script runs for EEA, UK, CH; incognito no-interaction cookie check

label: Input masking level
criteria: Masking at least Balanced; sensitive inputs masked; Strict for payment or health
business_effect: Relaxed masking records plaintext keystrokes, a PII breach
example_condition: Settings > Masking level; watch a form-interaction recording and confirm inputs show as asterisks

label: GA4 integration
criteria: Exactly one integration path (native or manual GTM); playback URL registered as GA4 custom dimension; GA4 kept as primary quant tool
business_effect: Recordings unreachable from GA4; double tagging; ad-network integrations break if GA4 deleted
example_condition: Settings > Setup GA4 toggle; GA4 Custom Definitions for playback-URL dimension; GA4 still firing

label: Google Ads integration
criteria: Clarity project linked to Google Ads
business_effect: No behavioral layer on paid traffic analysis
example_condition: Settings > Setup Ads toggle

label: Project hygiene
criteria: Site category selected; least-privilege team access; Copilot enabled; labels used; recurring filters saved as segments
business_effect: Generic reports; solo-admin access; manual-only analysis; filters rebuilt each session
example_condition: Settings > Overview, Team, Copilot; labels list; saved segments

label: Internal traffic filtering
criteria: IP blocking or non-IP approach configured; internal segment applied before AI analysis
business_effect: Internal sessions pollute recordings, heatmaps and dashboard metrics, and poison Copilot/AI summaries
example_condition: Copilot IP blocking config; internal-traffic exclusion segment applied before any AI summary run

label: Smart events health
criteria: Smart events configured, none broken, key journeys covered, all receiving recent data
business_effect: Broken or stale smart events; auto-detected events missing from list
example_condition: Settings > Smart Events inventory; per-event recency check

label: Custom tags recipe
criteria: Recipe custom tags in use with consistent values; delivered via GA4-event bridge
business_effect: Qualitative data unfilterable; typo'd or inconsistent tag values
example_condition: Filters > Custom Tags inventory vs recipe (page title, conversion action, conversion type, content group, ecommerce action, Purchase, userType, website error)

label: Identify API / custom identifiers
criteria: Identify called only when userID is available; no raw userID or PII in params
business_effect: Identify spammed with undefined values; raw email or ID sent as a parameter
example_condition: Instrumentation review of Identify API calls; Filters > Custom Filters populated

label: Funnels
criteria: Funnels set for key journeys on validated smart events; URL steps use contains logic
business_effect: Exact-match steps silently drop dynamic-URL traffic; key journeys missing
example_condition: Dashboard or Settings > Funnels review; per-step match logic check (contains vs exact)

label: Content Insights
criteria: Enabled for content sites; scoped to article pages only
business_effect: Skewed content metrics from non-article pages
example_condition: Dashboard > Content Insights page-scope review

label: Retention-aware evidence capture
criteria: Critical recordings downloaded or shared before expiry; audit findings backed by retained evidence
business_effect: Audit findings cite recordings that expired; claims unverifiable
example_condition: Retention windows (recordings about 30 days, sometimes 90; heatmaps about 1 year) vs audit timeline; evidence archive for cited sessions

label: Embedded-iframe recording blind spot
criteria: Iframe-embedded sections documented as recording blind spots
business_effect: Friction inside embedded widgets invisible, masked as no issues
example_condition: Watch a recording of an embedded iframe widget (Calendly and similar) to confirm it renders or is blank; cross-check iframe interactions via GA4 events

label: Multi-domain / subdomain Clarity project scope
criteria: One project ID deployed on all related subdomains; not reused across unrelated sites
business_effect: Checkout has zero recording coverage, or unrelated client sessions conflated
example_condition: Fetch checkout and app subdomain pages; check Clarity snippet and project ID match

label: Heatmap dynamic-URL aggregation
criteria: Path-contains filter aggregates the pattern into a template-level heatmap
business_effect: Per-URL heatmaps near-empty and not statistically meaningful
example_condition: Clarity heatmap for dynamic URL page type shows aggregate or low-sample individual pages

label: Clarity Data Export API key governance
criteria: Key rotated, scoped, not embedded client-side
business_effect: Key hardcoded in a public script or never rotated
example_condition: Where and how the Clarity Export API key is stored and referenced in integrations

label: Active vs inactive tab time methodology gap
criteria: Auditor understands GA4 counts background-tab time; expects GA4 greater than Clarity by design
business_effect: False discrepancy read as a bug; GA4 engagement inflated by background-tab time
example_condition: Cross-reference GA4 average engagement time vs Clarity active time for the same session cohort

label: DST transition date-boundary drift (analyst literacy note)
criteria: DST day recognised as calendar artifact, not a tracking anomaly
business_effect: Calendar artifact misread as tracking anomaly
example_condition: Check whether a flagged anomaly date coincides with the property timezone DST transition (23h or 25h day in hourly or daily local-TZ reports)

label: Multi-currency FX-rate reporting distortion (analyst literacy note)
criteria: FX-driven shifts in reporting currency understood before a discrepancy is raised
business_effect: Reporting-currency revenue appears to shift from exchange rate at time of transaction
example_condition: Compare local-currency totals (stable) against reporting-currency totals (FX-sensitive) for the same period before flagging a discrepancy

label: Privacy policy alignment
criteria: Privacy policy mirrors actual tracking and declares session-replay tooling
business_effect: Disclosure mismatch creates legal and trust exposure
example_condition: Legal disclosures compared with implementation (no data sharing plus Signals on is a mismatch); session-replay tools (Clarity, Hotjar) declared with opt-out and data-purge capability

label: CRM lead-quality feedback loop
criteria: Lifecycle stages reach ad platforms; lead counts reconcile within 5 percent
business_effect: Platforms optimise on raw leads, not qualified ones
example_condition: Lifecycle changes (Qualified, Closed Won) pushed back to platforms; GA4 vs CRM leads within plus or minus 5 percent

label: BigQuery reconciliation queries (appendix)
criteria: BigQuery totals match ERP within 5 percent; LTV and channel mix match finance
business_effect: Revenue and LTV views unreliable without finance tie-out
example_condition: Automated SQL reconciled against ERP within plus or minus 5 percent; LTV and channel-mix views cross-checked against finance

label: Dashboard accuracy (appendix)
criteria: BI dashboards reflect source of truth with no broken joins or stale caches
business_effect: Stakeholders act on wrong dashboard numbers
example_condition: Dashboards checked for broken joins, stale caches and quarterly schema validation against source of truth
